geeklist.title: Last Minute Christmas Sale! | Discounts for buying multiple items
geeklist.description:
[b][size=18]Last Minute Christmas Sale!! Obviously these will be delivered after Christmas but snag some deals while you can! [/size][/b]
SHIPS FROM LOS ANGELES 91403
Make sure you checkout the discounts!
[b][color=#ff0000]Discount Guidelines:[/color][/b] [size=18][b]Buy 3 items: 10% off Buy 5 items: 15% off Buy 10 items or more: 20% off[/b][/size]
If you're local to Los Angeles, you can pick up locally in Van Nuys or Hollywood and bypass shipping! And as an extra incentive, if you do local pickup and buy more than 10 items, [b]I'll knock off 25% off[/b].
1. End time: Tuesday evening December 30th 2025 at 9:00PM PST
Individual games with bidding activity in the last half hour of the auction will remain open for 5 minutes past the latest activity. To clarify, bids are open until 5 minutes of inactivity. (Example: A bid is placed at 8:59 pm. Now the auction remains open until 9:04 pm. Any further bids before 9:04 pm extend the auction an additional 5 min from the last bid time, and so forth.)
2. Bidding starts at increments of $1 or more
3. All Games have starting bids. Please do not undercut them as they are not soft reserves and I don't plan on accepting anything less than what's already stated.
4. Shipping will be from Los Angeles 91403, but I'm definitely open to meeting in person as well if you're local. I'll be using the cheapest option via Pirate ship for the CONUS only.
5. Exact Cash, Venmo, or Paypal FF is accepted. And BGG will get its 3% cut as well.
6. All games are specified exactly in their condition. I have pictures as well for a few so there's no confusion based off the description
7. Do not retract bids without notifying me first via a private message please
8. I reserve the right to pull any games from this auction and may add some games throughout the auction duration also.
9. Please do not Bid on anything if you don't have the intent of actually purchasing an item. So if you are on the fence, PLEASE reach out ahead of time!
If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact me. I'm pretty active on BGG so feel free to shoot me a private message via geekmail!
Happy Bidding!
